request.style: English, acoustic worship, warm male vocal with female harmony, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, intimate building to full, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They followed him across the sea
They'd eaten loaves and fish for free
They asked him for another sign
Like manna in the olden time

[Chorus]
I am the bread of life
Whoever comes to me will never hunger
And whoever believes in me will never thirst
I am the bread of life

[Verse]
Not the bread that fades by noon
Not the feast that ends too soon
Broken here for all to share
Bread of heaven, everywhere

[Chorus]
I am the bread of life
Whoever comes to me will never hunger
And whoever believes in me will never thirst
I am the bread of life

[Bridge]
I am the light of the world
Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness
But will have the light of life

[Outro]
I am the bread of life
I am the bread of life
